command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(hostname)" = 'ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein' || { echo HOST_MISMATCH:$(hostname); exit 77; }; V=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual; echo '=== IDENTITY ==='; hostname; id -un; date -Is; echo '=== LIVE SERVICE ==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-buehne.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart -p WorkingDirectory --no-pager; p=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-buehne.service -p MainPID --value); [ "$p" != 0 ] && { echo PID=$p; readlink -f /proc/$p/cwd; tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline; echo; }; echo '=== ACTIVE SOURCE HASHES ==='; for f in buehne.html buehne_daemon.py filmlook.js zustand.json; do [ -f "$V/$f" ] && stat -c '%y %s %n' "$V/$f" && sha256sum "$V/$f"; done; echo '=== HANDOFF ==='; ls -lht "$V/artifacts/handoff"/FRANK_AVATAR_HANDOFF_*.zip 2>/dev/null | head -8 || true; echo '=== ACTIVE AVATAR/CODE WORKERS ==='; ps -eo pid,lstart,etime,pcpu,pmem,args --sort=-pcpu | grep -Ei 'claude|codex|aider|buehne|avatar' | grep -v grep | head -100 || true; echo '=== RECENT VISUAL WRITES 30MIN ==='; find "$V" -maxdepth 2 -type f -mmin -30 -printf '%TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM:%TS %s %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -r | head -160; echo '=== LISTEN 8788 ==='; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep ':8788' || true
